scenario_splits.note: Train/validation/test seed ranges are disjoint integer ranges in Phase 3A's own namespace (520000-522999), never overlapping Phase 1's default seed (0) or Phase 2A/2B's controlled-scenario namespace (410000-414999). Every scenario is built by the frozen Phase 1 generate_scenario function -- never a Phase-3A-local reimplementation -- so every guarantee generate_scenario already makes (>=1 usable provider when the pool is non-empty, etc.) applies identically to every split.

state_encoding.note: Upper bound derived purely from this encoder's own field cardinalities; does NOT account for domain-reachability constraints (strict workflow ordering, housing-only-after-provider-selection, etc.) that make the number of states any planner can ever actually visit, per fixed scenario, much smaller in practice (Phase 2A/2B BFS/A* measured ~20-30 expanded nodes per scenario). See docs/phase3a_review.md for the empirical Q-table size this project's experiments actually reached.

metadata.note: This script does not itself re-run `pytest tests/`; docs/phase3a_review.md records the full-suite result for this run.
